questions.text: Where is the WKU campus located?
questions.hint: "The university campus is located in the northern part of the city, on Dostyq Avenue."

questions.text: Uralsk has a metro system that students can use.
questions.hint: "The city has no metro and limited night transport."

questions.text: In Text 2, why couldn't Rustam get on a bus at first?
opts: He was too embarrassed to ask which bus
The stop was on the wrong side
questions.correct: He was too embarrassed to ask which bus
questions.hint: "I didn't know which number to take, and I was too embarrassed to ask."

questions.text: Rustam found a shortcut that cut his journey to the library from 12 to ___ minutes.
questions.hint: "he could get to the library in six minutes instead of twelve."

questions.text: What does the final paragraph of Text 2 say about knowing a city?
opts: Walking builds knowledge that no map can capture
questions.correct: Walking builds knowledge that no map can capture
questions.hint: "a city that is walked, not just visited, becomes familiar in a way that no map can fully capture."

questions.text: Rustam found the best shashlyk restaurant through a recommendation.
questions.hint: "He found the city's best shashlyk restaurant — completely by accident, by going down the wrong street."

questions.text: Where is Daniyar when he calls Rustam?
opts: At the bus stop opposite the Central Mosque
questions.correct: At the bus stop opposite the Central Mosque
questions.hint: "I'm at the bus stop opposite the Central Mosque."

questions.text: Where should Daniyar cross the road?
opts: Just past the bank at a pedestrian crossing
questions.correct: Just past the bank at a pedestrian crossing
questions.hint: "Just past the bank, there's a pedestrian crossing. Cross the road there."

questions.text: Daniyar walks ___ a tunnel under the railway line.
questions.hint: "Walk through a short tunnel under the railway line."

questions.text: The large blue glass building is the library.
questions.hint: "That's not the library — that's the city administration."

questions.text: How does Daniyar reach the library entrance?
opts: Up the steps and through the main entrance
questions.correct: Up the steps and through the main entrance
questions.hint: "Go up the steps and through the main entrance."

questions.text: What does Daniyar NOT do when he passes the park?
opts: Notice a café on the corner
questions.hint: "Go past a small park on your right — don't go into the park, just keep going straight."

questions.text: "The library is ___ the second floor."
questions.hint: "on the second floor" — floors use "on". ✅

questions.text: "She studies ___ WKU ___ Uralsk."
questions.hint: "at WKU" (institution) + "in Uralsk" (city). ✅

questions.text: "Walk ___ the road." (from one side to the other)
questions.hint: "across" = one side to the other of an open space. ✅

questions.text: "Walk ___ the tunnel." (enter and exit)
questions.hint: "through" = enclosed space, enter and exit. ✅

questions.text: "The university is ___ Dostyq Avenue."
questions.hint: "on" + street/avenue name. "The university is ON Dostyq Avenue." ✅

questions.text: "Go ___ the bank." (without stopping, continue beyond)
questions.hint: "past" = go beyond without stopping. "Go PAST the bank." ✅

questions.text: "She walked ___ the building." (entering)
questions.hint: "into" = entering a space. "She walked INTO the building." ✅

questions.text: "Come ___ the tunnel — you can see the building now."
questions.hint: "out of" = exiting. "Come OUT OF the tunnel." ✅

questions.text: "A landmark" is:
opts: A well-known feature used to identify location
questions.correct: A well-known feature used to identify location
questions.hint: "landmark" = a well-known, recognisable feature used to give directions or orientation.

questions.text: "The area is compact." "Compact" means:
opts: Small but well-organised and easy to navigate
questions.correct: Small but well-organised and easy to navigate
questions.hint: "compact" = small in area but containing everything in close proximity.

questions.text: He found a ___ through the garden that saved him six minutes.
questions.hint: "shortcut" = a quicker route than the usual one.

questions.text: "The first day was disorienting." "Disorienting" means:
opts: Making you confused about where you are
questions.correct: Making you confused about where you are
questions.hint: "disorienting" = causing confusion about direction and location.

questions.text: "He learned the routes through trial and error." This means:
opts: He learned by trying things and making mistakes until it worked
questions.correct: He learned by trying things and making mistakes until it worked
questions.hint: "trial and error" = the process of learning by trying different things until you find what works.
